definitionZh: 文本装饰- skip CSS 属性设定元素内容中任何影响元素的文本装饰必须跳过 。 它控制元素绘制的所有文字装饰线,以及其祖先绘制的任何文字装饰线.
sourceDefinition: The text-decoration-skip CSS property sets what parts of an element's content any text decoration affecting the element must skip over. It controls all text decoration lines drawn by the element and also any text decoration lines drawn by its ancestors.
